avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce UGT1A9, potentially reducing empagliflozin exposure and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative herbal supplement if needed and monitor glucose control closely

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Fenugreek
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Independent hypoglycemic effects may additive with empagliflozin, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use cautiously; requires increased glucose monitoring and possible dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild glucose-lowering effects; potential for additive hypoglycemic effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; may require dose adjustment of empagliflozin or supplement

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modestly improve insulin sensitivity; potential additive glucose reduction
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on hypoglycemia signs; monitor glucose levels if concurrent use desired

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Empagliflozin increases urinary sodium excretion; excessive sodium intake may counteract fluid/electrolyte balance benefits
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderate sodium intake (<2.3g/day) to optimize cardiovascular benefits

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol may increase dehydration and euglycemic DKA risk, particularly with SGLT2 inhibitors
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol to moderate amounts; educate on DKA signs (nausea, shortness of breath, abdominal pain)

monitoring_notes: Empagliflozin undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism via UGT1A9, making true drug interactions less common. Monitor for genital mycotic infections, euglycemic DKA (especially in acute illness), volume depletion, and acute kidney injury; counsel patients on adequate hydration and sick day management.
